
A '''gismu''' consists either of an [[Morphology: consonants nitial-pair]], a [[Morphology: vowels tressed-vowel]], and a [[Morphology: syllables inal-syllable]] composed of [[Morphology: consonants onsonant]] [[Morphology: vowels owel]] (CCVCV), or of a [[Morphology: consonants onsonant]], a [[Morphology: vowels tressed-vowel]], a [[Morphology: consonants onsonant]], and a [[Morphology: syllables inal-syllable]] composed of [[Morphology: consonants onsonant]] [[Morphology: vowels owel]] (CVC/CV).
